caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a lid, shown at an angle to reveal both the front and the right side. The chest is predominantly brown, suggesting a wood texture, with linear shading to indicate grain and dimension. The front face of the chest features two large, circular, floral-like carvings, each with radiating petal shapes outlined in a reddish-brown color and a central point highlighted in pink. Between these carvings, there is a black keyhole plate positioned at the top center, and beneath it runs a vertical row of small, rounded studs or knobs. The right side of the chest features a single, similar circular carving with the same pattern and colors. The side panel has a slightly greenish hue in the wood, contrasting with the front. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white with no additional objects or details. In the bottom right corner of the page, the name "M. PARISH" is written in all capitals.
title: Chest
